questions.question: Paul told the church in Corinth he became an apostle of Christ Jesus by his own choice. True or false?
In his letter to the church in Corinth, Paul wished them grace and peace from whom?

answers.text: God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ
All the churches of Christ everywhere

questions.question: Paul told the church in Corinth they had been enriched in Christ in which two ways?

answers.text: In all speech and all knowledge
